editorial:
Imagine two NYPD detectives who are totally out of their element, suddenly dropped into the fancy world of French high fashion. You get to follow Luis and Eddie as they head to Paris to help a stunning designer named Colette find a thief who stole her handbag designs. It is a classic fish-out-of-water story where these two unhip guys try to blend into a world of expensive cafes and wild nightclubs. The vibe is light, breezy, and focused on the funny clashes between New York street smarts and Parisian luxury.

You will likely enjoy the chemistry between the lead actors, as their bickering makes the slower parts of the plot move faster. While the mystery is not super complex, the scenery and the laughs keep you interested. If you want something relaxing to watch on a Friday night, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best visuals of the city. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this feel-good comedy handy for whenever you need a laugh.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when Luis and Eddie use their detective skills to expose the real thief hiding within the corporate fashion world. After a chaotic chase, they catch the culprit and return the stolen designs to Colette. Luis finds a romantic spark with the designer, and the partners head back to New York with a new appreciation for France. It ends on a happy note with the bad guys in jail and the heroes winning the day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted comedies and travel stories.
